summary: Created beads issues: saad-new-06k (remove/replace placeholder EXAMPLE.astro content), saad-new-qc3 (replace placeholder social links in Navbar), saad-new-nnq (align global color tokens with design guide palette), saad-new-5en (fix README encoding artifacts).
Created complete dentist website with Navbar, Hero, Services, About, Testimonials, CTA, and Footer sections using frontend-design skill.
Established design system with color variables (ivory, sage, terracotta) and responsive layouts. All components feature smooth animations and hover effects.
Updated index.astro to integrate all components and added global CSS variables for consistent theming across the site.

Fixed typography consistency across all components (saad-new-kjj). Added Google Fonts @import to all 6 components (Services, About, Testimonials, CTA, Footer). Applied Manrope font to all body text elements, Plus Jakarta Sans to headings.
Consolidated Google Fonts @import statements into BaseLayout and removed per-component imports.
Added MCP server usage instructions to AGENTS.md.
Expanded AGENTS.md MCP section to list available servers and usage steps.
Added sequential-thinking and playwright to MCP list in AGENTS.md.
Added quick MCP usage examples to AGENTS.md.
Created a design guide that documents the current visual system, tokens, and component patterns in docs/design-guide.md.
Applied BaseLayout to index.astro and added layout props to control navbar and main padding.
Centralized design tokens in global.css and replaced hardcoded palette values with CSS variables across components.
Restored global.css design tokens and nav palette so components render correct colors and contrast.
Created SectionHeader Astro component for repeated section headers and updated Services/Testimonials to use it; noted no shared button component due to divergent styles.
Adjusted hero mobile layout so text content appears before the visual on small screens.
Removed placeholder EXAMPLE.astro component to avoid shipping demo content.
Improved contrast for the Services 'Most Popular' card list items by lightening text color on the featured card.
Adjusted mobile hero navbar CTA button sizing to prevent text wrapping.
Added mobile nav toggle in DentistHero with dropdown links and CTA in the menu.
Tightened mobile hero spacing to reduce bottom whitespace by adjusting padding and visual element margins.
Further reduced mobile hero whitespace by shrinking visual stack (hide smile illustration) and tightening padding/gaps.
Reduced Services section headline size on mobile to avoid truncation.
Applied a mobile typography override in SectionHeader to reduce Services headline size on small screens.
Fixed README template encoding artifacts by rewriting the README with clean ASCII text and structure.
Added a subtle bottom shadow to the fixed navbar for better separation from page content.
Made the navbar content data-driven by sourcing logo text, links, and CTA from src/data/navData.json.
Added dropdown support to the navbar by nesting child links in navData and rendering a hoverable submenu in the navbar and mobile menu.
Investigated Astro build EPERM; root cause is Node child_process spawn being blocked in this environment, causing Vite net use check to fail. Marked beads issue as blocked with workaround notes.
Closed qc3 as obsolete because the current navbar has no social links to replace.
Made Services section data-driven by moving section copy and cards into src/data/serviceData.json and rendering from that data.
Fixed Services data-driven rendering by moving SVG icons to HTML strings and using set:html to avoid Astro frontmatter JSX parse errors.
Updated AGENTS.md to require checking for errors and fixing them before committing.
Made Footer data-driven via src/data/footerData.json and mapped brand, columns, contact, hours, and bottom links; added icon maps with typed Records.
Updated AGENTS.md to require sequential-thinking at the start of tasks and to use MCPs as needed.
Made Testimonials data-driven via src/data/testimonialData.json and rendered section, cards, and rating summary from data.
Verified global color tokens already match the design guide palette; closed nnq with no code changes.
